content.text: Read data/dummy_customers.csv and give me a quick profile: number of rows, columns, nulls, and basic statistics.
Break down the score column by segment: average, minimum and maximum. Tell me which segment appears riskiest.
The review_flag looks manually assigned. Can you infer what score threshold most closely reproduces it?
Apply that threshold and show me the false positives and false negatives compared with the existing flag.
Put this analysis into a Python script called score_review.py so I can rerun it when the CSV changes.
Sometimes the segment column has a different name. Move the column mappings into a config file so the script isn't hardcoded.
Add a short README and a requirements.txt so another person can install and run this.
Make this easier for them: create a single Windows batch file that installs the dependencies and runs the analysis automatically.
